# Tip for completing the Explore Places in Burning Springs Challenge

![Tip for completing the Explore Places in Burning Springs challenge](/uploads/606_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Since the Burning Springs update on December 2nd, 2025, there have been new challenges including a challenge to discover 14 places in Burning Springs. But unfortunately there are problems with this challenge. Although the locations are discovered, many players do not complete the challenge.

*Despite the hotfix, there is currently no solution from Bethesda, so I'm sharing the tip here so that even more players know it.*

### Challenge is not completing for many players in some locations

| Explore places in Burning Springs. | Title: [Sweaty:r] | 14 | 
| Discover Ash Cave. | | 1 | 
| Discover Athens | | 1 | 
| Discover the canyon checkpoint. | | 1 | 
| Discover the Chop Shop. | | 1 | 
| Discover the world of corn. | | 1 | 
| Discover Dino Peaks mini golf. | | 1 | 
| Discover Fort Steuben. | | 1 | 
| Discover Highway Town. | | 1 | 
| Discover Hocking Hills Station. | | 1 | 
| Discover the Jackson Junkyard. | | 1 | 
| Discover the Rust Kingdom. | | 1 | 
| Discover Tycoon Lake. | | 1 | 
| Discover the Starlight drive-in cinema. | | 1 | 
| Discover the Super Duper Mart. | | 1 | 

As a reward you will receive the player title "[Sweaty:r]"

### With this trick you complete the challenge

Credit: CensorErik (Mr. Church Discord)

This trick was first shared by user "CensorErik" in the Discord by YouTuber "Mr. Church", but has been doing the rounds for a few days now. Thanks for sharing, CensorErik!

1. Make sure you are “tracking” the challenge.
2. Go to a location that was not unlocked in your challenge. Ideally in the middle of the town, not just on the edge.
3. Open the map and join a daily operation.
4. Completely close the game while in the daily operation.
5. Join a new world and your challenge for that location will be completed.
6. Repeat if necessary.

This trick works on all platforms. I also completed the challenge myself because it couldn't be completed the normal way.
